items.stem: Match LIST-I with LIST-II. LIST-I: A. Chi-square test; B. Wilcoxon signed rank test; C. Mann–Whitney U-test; D. Kruskal–Wallis test. LIST-II: I. One-way ANOVA; II. Homogeneity in contingency table; III. To compare the means of two independent populations; IV. To compare the means of two related populations.
items.explanation: Idea: match each test to its design: a contingency table (chi-square), paired samples (signed rank), two independent samples (Mann–Whitney), and several independent samples, the rank version of one-way ANOVA (Kruskal–Wallis). Working: Chi-square: homogeneity in a contingency table (II); signed rank: paired/related samples (IV); Mann–Whitney: two independent samples (III); Kruskal–Wallis: the rank analogue of one-way ANOVA (I). Official answer: A (A-II, B-IV, C-III, D-I).
